sections.label: Integrating
sections.heading: Project SENTINEL — Senior Spacecraft Design
paragraphs: I'm the integration engineer on Project SENTINEL, a 3U CubeSat designed to autonomously catalog resident space objects in the GEO belt. I coordinate five subteams, wrote the CONOPS from the mission needs document, and I'm deriving requirements from both ahead of our System Requirements Review.

sections.label: Testing
sections.heading: Aerospace Structures and Instrumentation Lab — AE 416/417
paragraphs: I'm installing strain gages on test specimens and checking our static load test results against theory.

sections.heading: An entry-level systems engineering role
paragraphs: I graduate in May 2027 with a B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, astronautics concentration, and I'm looking for an entry-level systems engineering position.

sections.label: Recently finished
sections.heading: AI Exploration Intern — EPI-USE America
paragraphs: From May to September I was an AI Exploration Intern at EPI-USE America. I compared build-versus-buy options for software and wrote recommendation briefs that practice leaders used to make decisions, built a Python tool that scrapes public procurement portals and found 5× more relevant opportunities, and built an AWS workflow that scores a proposal request requirement by requirement.

I was particularly interested in how AI fits inside engineering workflows specifically, not productivity software in general. The design-analyze-test loop in aerospace has different constraints than text-based knowledge work, and most existing AI tooling doesn't reflect that yet.
